subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this built-in `rescueWatchdog` cron/service-control feature once the branch is rebased and real recovery proof is supplied?
rationale: The PR adds a new core cron payload and local service-control repair path that affects availability and security boundaries, while related open issues still mark the broader recovery direction as needing maintainer product/security review.

options.title: Sponsor After Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open, require rebase plus real managed-host recovery proof, and review it as the core rescue-watchdog path.

options.title: Defer To Recovery Ladder
options.body: Keep or close this PR in favor of the broader open recovery-ladder issue if maintainers want a different architecture first.

options.title: Reject Core Watchdog
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide this recovery loop should remain operator-managed or live outside core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require rebase plus real managed-host recovery proof, and review it as the core rescue-watchdog path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core product/security direction choice and the PR discussion already routed maintainer review requests to this handle.
